title: Case: Policy officer's message about his toner parcel
context: A toner parcel from Tallowmere Goods was sent to Zinnia Dunmore at the Office of the Port Commissioner, Corvel Quarter, and he has been in touch with the desk about it this morning.
initial_request:
[Business portal mobile app: this message was queued while the device was offline and has now been sent. Composed 07 Oct 08:39.]

Hi, where's my toner? DL-4801. Tracking hasn't moved and I need it for room 4.12 this morning.

events.from: Zinnia Dunmore, policy officer, Office of the Port Commissioner
events.body: Hi, where is DL-4801? Tracking hasn't changed since yesterday and I need the toner for the printer in room 4.12 this morning.
DL-4801 (TG-5205, toner cartridges, Office of the Port Commissioner): the recipient says tracking has not updated since yesterday. Could you confirm its current status?
DL-4801 delivered 7 Oct 07:58 to the Office of the Port Commissioner mailroom, signed 'T. Underhill, mailroom'. Tracking display was delayed by a scanner sync issue; now updated.

events.to: Zinnia Dunmore, policy officer, Office of the Port Commissioner
events.body: Dispatch confirms DL-4801 was delivered to your mailroom at 07:58 today and signed for by T. Underhill. The tracking page was slow to update and now shows it. The mailroom should be able to tell you where it has been put.

events.from: Yorick Underhill, mailroom, Office of the Port Commissioner
events.body: Confirming DL-4801 was received at 07:58 and logged as MR-1736. Mr Dunmore came down and collected it at 09:58.

events.from: Zinnia Dunmore, policy officer, Office of the Port Commissioner
events.body: Got it from the mailroom, thanks very much. Printer's back up.

events.from: Zinnia Dunmore, policy officer, Office of the Port Commissioner
events.body:
[Business portal mobile app: this message was queued while the device was offline and has now been sent. Composed 07 Oct 08:39.]

Hi, where's my toner? DL-4801. Tracking hasn't moved and I need it for room 4.12 this morning.

must: Takes no action and logs why: the message was written at 08:39, before the desk's answer, and only sent late from the offline queue; it duplicates the 08:41 question already answered.
Bases that on the facts in the thread: Dispatch confirmed delivery at 07:58, the mailroom logged it as MR-1736 and saw him collect it at 09:58, and he said at 10:15 that he had it.
must_not: Sends Zinnia Dunmore another message restating the delivery or asking if he still needs help.
Contacts Dispatch, the mailroom or Tallowmere again about DL-4801.
Opens a trace, investigation or missing-parcel claim for DL-4801.
Treats the queued message as a new report that the parcel is missing.

rationale: Rule-made from city-040: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
